title: What Does the Effective Dimension of a Hybrid Quantum Neural Network Actually Measure?
abstract: arXiv:2610.14070v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hybrid quantum neural networks (QNNs) pass features from a classical backbone into a variational quantum circuit, and many studies log a scalar called the effective dimension as a sign of capacity or model quality. The effective dimension is usually defined as the participation ratio (PR) of the quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM), but studies in practice log a PR of cheap parameter sensitivities instead, and the meaning of that scalar is rarely tested. We show that the logged scalar equals the PR of Pauli-Z output sensitivities, that each sensitivity is at most n times its QFIM diagonal entry on n qubits, and that a PR of the QFIM diagonal overstates the full-matrix PR by an exact factor set by the off-diagonal mass. We then test the scalar on CIFAR-10 and EuroSAT with four frozen backbones, one of them a random projection, over 4 to 16 qubits, 1 to 4 layers, three entangling patterns, and three seeds. translated_title: 混合量子神经网络的有效维度究竟衡量的是什么？
translated_abstract: 混合量子神经网络（QNN）将经典骨干网络提取的特征传入变分量子线路，许多研究记录一个名为“有效维度”的标量，将其作为模型容量或质量的标志。有效维度通常被定义为量子费舍尔信息矩阵（QFIM）的参与率（PR），但在实际研究中，人们记录的往往是计算成本更低的参数敏感度的参与率，而这一标量的真正含义很少得到检验。我们证明：所记录的标量等于泡利-Z输出敏感度的参与率；在 n 个量子比特上，每个敏感度至多是其对应 QFIM 对角元的 n 倍；并且用 QFIM 对角元计算的参与率会以一个由非对角元素质量精确决定的因子高估全矩阵的参与率。随后，我们在 CIFAR-10 和 EuroSAT 数据集上，使用四个冻结的骨干网络（其中之一为随机投影），在 4 到 16 个量子比特、1 到 4 层线路、三种纠缠模式和三个随机种子下对该标量进行测试。在固定线路的情况下，（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明混合量子神经网络研究中实际记录的“有效维度”标量只是泡利-Z输出敏感度的参与率，并非理论定义的量子费舍尔信息矩阵全矩阵参与率，并通过大规模实验表明该标量不能可靠地衡量模型容量。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the "effective dimension" scalar commonly logged for hybrid quantum neural networks actually equals the participation ratio of Pauli-Z output sensitivities rather than the full quantum Fisher information matrix, and extensive experiments show it is an unreliable proxy for model capacity.
